system.notes:
Survival (specific)

Training Time (TT): 30 weeks

Ability to forage for food and water, navigate, and find or construct suitable shelter in the wilds. Also includes knowledge of the flora and fauna of a given region, including techniques for hunting, capturing, and using their remains. Each different terrain is a different Survival skill. The different sub-skills include: Savannah, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Arctic, Swamp, Alpine, Aquatic, and Urban. GMs are encouraged to add any other terrain types they deem required for their game world.
